verdict.rationale: TruffleHog lets users choose between hosted scanners (managed by Truffle Security) and self-hosted scanners running in their own environment, and the open-source CLI/Docker image runs locally. That gives users control over where their data lives, though only through deployment choice rather than an explicit residency feature. missing for 10: region selection or data-residency controls for the hosted offering, documentation of where hosted data and findings are stored, independent corroboration.
